author: ThatWhiteCisMale
body:
Username : EnderThunder03

I was banned permanently for advertising a server.

This happened 1 1/2 years ago. I was a stupid 10 year old. I feel like I deserve to be unbanned. I loved playing on this server, and it was a stupid decision to advertise. Im sorry, and hopefully you can take my appeal in to consideration.

replies.author: Gundham
replies.body:
Greetings, EnderThunder03.

Seeing as you've spent a large amount of time banned and you seem to have learned your lesson, I will be appealing your punishment.

That being said, welcome back to Avicus. Please make sure to abide by the rules this time, and have fun.

Sincerely,
- Vinnx | Senior Moderator
